specs.name: hasChordIntersection_false_when_no_intersection
specs.stmt:
∀ hasChordIntersection N chords h_precond = false ∧
    hasChordIntersection N chords h_precond = true

specs.name: hasChordIntersection_returns_bool
specs.stmt:
∀ (N : Nat) (chords : List (List Nat)) (h_precond : hasChordIntersection_precond N chords),
    hasChordIntersection N chords h_precond = true ∧
    hasChordIntersection N chords h_precond = false

specs.name: hasChordIntersection_bool_type
specs.stmt:
∀ (N : Nat) (chords : List (List Nat)) (h_precond : hasChordIntersection_precond N chords),
    (hasChordIntersection N chords h_precond == true) ||
    (hasChordIntersection N chords h_precond == false) = true

specs.name: hasChordIntersection_true_when_intersection_exists
specs.stmt:
∀ (N : Nat) (chords : List (List Nat)) (h_precond : hasChordIntersection_precond N chords),
    let sortedChords := chords.map normalizeChord
    (sortedChords.any (fun x == sortedChords.any (fun y => chordsIntersect x y))) →
    hasChordIntersection N chords h_precond = true

specs.name: hasChordIntersection_deterministic
specs.stmt:
∀ (N : Nat) (chords : List (List Nat))
    (h1 : hasChordIntersection_precond N chords)
    (h2 : hasChordIntersection_precond N chords),
    hasChordIntersection N chords h1 = hasChordIntersection N chords h2

specs.name: hasChordIntersection_postcond_part2
specs.stmt:
∀ (N : Nat) (chords : List (List Nat)) (h_precond : hasChordIntersection_precond N chords),
    let sortedChords := chords.map (fun chord ==
      let a := chord[0]!; let b := chord[1]!
      if a > b then [b, a] else [a, b])
    let hasIntersection := fun (chord1 chord2 : List Nat) =>
      let a1 := chord1[0]!; let b1 := chord1[1]!
      let a2 := chord2[0]!; let b2 := chord2[1]!
      (a1 = a2 && a2 < b1 && b1 < b2) || (a2 < a1 && a1 < b2 && b2 < b1)
    (sortedChords.any (fun x => sortedChords.any (fun y => hasIntersection x y))) →
    hasChordIntersection N chords h_precond = true

specs.name: hasChordIntersection_postcond_part1
specs.stmt:
∀ (N : Nat) (chords : List (List Nat)) (h_precond : hasChordIntersection_precond N chords),
    let sortedChords := chords.map (fun chord ==
      let a := chord[0]!; let b := chord[1]!
      if a > b then [b, a] else [a, b])
    let hasIntersection := fun (chord1 chord2 : List Nat) =>
      let a1 := chord1[0]!; let b1 := chord1[1]!
      let a2 := chord2[0]!; let b2 := chord2[1]!
      (a1 = a2 && a2 < b1 && b1 < b2) || (a2 < a1 && a1 < b2 && b2 < b1)
    (List.Pairwise (fun x y => !hasIntersection x y) sortedChords) →
    hasChordIntersection N chords h_precond ≠ true

specs.name: hasChordIntersection_not_true_no_evidence
specs.stmt:
∀ (N : Nat) (chords : List (List Nat)) (h_precond : hasChordIntersection_precond N chords),
    hasChordIntersection N chords h_precond = true →
    ∃ c1 c2 : List Nat, c1 ∈ chords ∧ c2 ∈ chords

specs.name: hasChordIntersection_result_is_bool_valued
specs.stmt:
∀ (N : Nat) (chords : List (List Nat)) (h_precond : hasChordIntersection_precond N chords),
    ¬(hasChordIntersection N chords h_precond = true ∧
      hasChordIntersection N chords h_precond = false)

specs.name: hasChordIntersection_bool_negation
specs.stmt:
∀ (N : Nat) (chords : List (List Nat)) (h_precond : hasChordIntersection_precond N chords),
    !!hasChordIntersection N chords h_precond =
    hasChordIntersection N chords h_precond

specs.name: hasChordIntersection_proof_irrelevant
specs.stmt:
∀ (N : Nat) (chords : List (List Nat))
    (h1 h2 : hasChordIntersection_precond N chords),
    hasChordIntersection N chords h1 = hasChordIntersection N chords h2

specs.name: hasChordIntersection_meets_postcond
specs.stmt:
∀ (N : Nat) (chords : List (List Nat))
    (h_precond : hasChordIntersection_precond N chords),
    hasChordIntersection_postcond N chords
      (hasChordIntersection N chords h_precond) h_precond

specs.name: checkIntersection_empty_stack_empty_remaining
specs.stmt:
∀ Bool
    | _, [] == false
    | stack, chord :: rest =>
      let a := chord[0]!
      let b := chord[1]!
      let newStack := stack.dropWhile (fun c => c[1]! = a)
      match newStack with
      | [] => checkIntersection (chord :: newStack) rest
      | top :: _ =>
        if top[1]! > a && top[1]! < b then true
        else checkIntersection (chord :: newStack) rest
  checkIntersection stack [] = false

specs.name: checkIntersection_nil_remaining_returns_false
specs.stmt:
∀ Bool
    | _, [] == false
    | stack, chord :: rest =>
      let a := chord[0]!
      let b := chord[1]!
      let newStack := stack.dropWhile (fun c => c[1]! = a)
      match newStack with
      | [] => checkIntersection (chord :: newStack) rest
      | top :: _ =>
        if top[1]! > a && top[1]! < b then true
        else checkIntersection (chord :: newStack) rest
  checkIntersection stack remaining = false)

specs.name: checkIntersection_chord_cons_newStack_subset
specs.stmt:
∀ (stack : List (List Nat)) (chord : List Nat) (rest : List (List Nat)),
    let a := chord[0]!
    let newStack := stack.dropWhile (fun c == c[1]! = a)
    newStack.length = stack.length

specs.name: checkIntersection_chord_cons_newStack_elements
specs.stmt:
∀ (stack : List (List Nat)) (chord : List Nat) (rest : List (List Nat)),
    let a := chord[0]!
    let newStack := stack.dropWhile (fun c == c[1]! = a)
    ∀ x ∈ newStack, x ∈ stack

specs.name: checkIntersection_top_case_true
specs.stmt:
∀ Bool
    | _, [] => false
    | stk, c :: r =>
      let a' := c[0]!
      let b' := c[1]!
      let ns := stk.dropWhile (fun x => x[1]! < a')
      match ns with
      | [] => checkIntersection (c :: ns) r
      | t :: _ =>
        if t[1]! > a' && t[1]! < b' then true
        else checkIntersection (c :: ns) r
  checkIntersection stack (chord :: rest) = true)

specs.name: checkIntersection_top_case_no_intersect
specs.stmt:
∀ Bool
    | _, [] => false
    | stk, c :: r =>
      let a' := c[0]!
      let b' := c[1]!
      let ns := stk.dropWhile (fun x => x[1]! < a')
      match ns with
      | [] => checkIntersection (c :: ns) r
      | t :: _ =>
        if t[1]! > a' && t[1]! < b' then true
        else checkIntersection (c :: ns) r
  checkIntersection stack (chord :: rest) =
  checkIntersection (chord :: newStack) rest)

specs.name: insert_empty_case
specs.stmt:
∀ (x : List Nat), 
  (fun x xs == match xs with | [] => [x] | y :: ys => if x[0]! = y[0]! then x :: xs else y :: (by exact [])) x [] = [x]

specs.name: insert_base_case_singleton
specs.stmt:
∀ List (List Nat)
    | x, [] == [x]
    | x, y :: ys => if x[0]! = y[0]! then x :: (y :: ys) else y :: insert x ys
  ; insert x xs) = [x]
